title: A Secret Lie in Love
description: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. But, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man.

title: Blind Tiez
description: Naire is on the up and up as he's recently been promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

title: The Offer
description: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision.

title: Only 48
description: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape, Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.

title: Unintended Consequences
description: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother's honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

title: Clutch
description: An anxiety-ridden thief enlists the help of his brother and friend after an unexpected death during a crime.

title: Everything I Never Expected
description: Opposites attract when a spoiled bachelor and broke college grad accidentally become roommates. Forced to share a cramped apartment, they overcome life's challenges and misunderstandings, and find love in the most unexpected place.

title: Twisted Marriage
description: Two married couples, who have been long-time friends, decide to swap partners for a weekend, leading to many questions and jealousy.

title: The Jealous Son
description: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

title: The Special Affect
description: Expecting mother and artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

title: Kinfolk
description: Eboni is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown, with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Things get complicated when their father attempts to reconcile for the past.

title: Women of the Jury
description: A man is on trial accused of the murder of two young Black men, and 12 women are called to serve on the jury. After deliberation, one juror is convinced the man is not guilty, while the majority claims he is guilty.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

title: Reality TV Murders
description: Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show "Diva's Doing it'." When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of them would literally kill to be famous.

title: Desperate Desires
description: Marathon runner Mia is pursued by Jay, while Tori and Paul desire a baby. A one-night stand leaves Mia pregnant, creates an opportunity for Tori and Paul. When Mia disappears, a darker plot ensues. Whose desires will prevail?

title: The Perfect Mother
description: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody.

title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
description: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins

title: Fatal Promises
description: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their.

title: My Man
description: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession.

title: Smash and Dash
description: A Chef from Chicago needs to hook up with many women without falling in love.

title: Ebony Hustle 2: Ballistic Protection
description: Local detective and icon Ebony Hustle returns and hopes to grow into her new life. She starts a romance with Marc, and up-and-coming basketball player, with a secret to hide, when she then encounters and old rival who hasn't let go of the past.

title: Hidden Agenda
description: Bright and gifted Jessica takes on a side hustle tutoring popular football star, Ryan. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When Ryan is found dead, multiple people are suspects.

title: The Bayou City Murders
description: Houston police officer Tamara Haynes takes a bold interest in recent murders of women in Houston's South Side, believing there is likely a serial killer on the loose.

title: Finding Boaz
description: After a failed engagement, Torrey is afraid of becoming a lonely spinster. Torrey solicits the help of her cousin Nell, who enrolls her in a "How to Catch a Man" school. Torrey catches far more than she bargained for.

title: Then There Was You
description: Lady's man Kingston gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Shandre, a spoken-word artist who introduces him to a lifestyle deeply rooted in African American culture.

title: The Price of Fame
description: Cassie, a young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry.

title: ToxiCity
description: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order.

title: Three of a Kind
description: Three years after graduation, college friends Hope, Chanta and May eagerly reunite for Hope's wedding to her fiancé, Robert. As the weekend unfolds, a secret emerges. When the truth comes to light, the celebration descends into chaos.

title: The New Girl
description: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

title: Trouble
description: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.

title: Something Old
description: Days from her wedding, Kara meets her ex, Malik, for one last goodbye. But Malik wants her back and won't take no for an answer, turning a hotel meetup into a dangerous game of obsession. Can Jordan uncover the truth before time runs out?

title: Blood in the Comments
description: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has a live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend's sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confront him.

title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
description: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart.

title: Widower Syndrome
description: Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone.

title: I Hate I Love You
description: A successful power couple is tested by betrayal and illegal activity. Both love and business face being destroyed.

title: Despise Not, My Youth
description: An arrogant, disrespectful, mischievous teenager is up to no good when he hears the voice of God, who instructs him to change his ways.

title: His Last Wife
description: Following the death of her district attorney husband, Nivea McKenzie sets out to find the person responsible. By digging into his past, Nivea discovers that she knew nothing about the man she married.

title: American Girl
description: A determined 19-year-old girl escapes her toxic stepfather in rural Georgia, embarking on a challenging journey to survival on the streets of Atlanta.

title: Who's Watching Us
description: When Ruth is hired to babysit for the Harris family, she and the kids find out that someone else is watching them closely. Ruth and Jasmine must fight to protect themselves and her little brother Micah.

title: Double Blended
description: Two married couples that were once married to each other's ex-spouse have pleasantly coped with a double blended family lifestyle until an upcoming event causes a disturbance.

title: The Only Child
description: Chris has a wonderful and thriving childhood with her loving family. When her mother dies tragically in a car accident, she begins to go down a dark and sinister path, and develops a fierce devotion to her father.

title: Kitty Hallow Killer
description: Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband could be a known serial killer.

title: Boxed In
description: Ria is an up-and-coming female boxer whose one and only focus is to be the best boxer alive. That's until she meets Tuga, who shows her that a life without love really isn't a life at all.

title: Boxed In 2
description: Ria finds herself a rising star in the world of boxing. She meets El by chance and starts to let go of her past disappointments and grab hold of hope for the future.

title: Broken Harmony
description: Harmony is on the verge of being dropped from her record label; her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta to refresh her sound; she must reunite with her mother and is forced to face her childhood trauma.

title: Contusion
description: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invades their home. As he navigates through the aftermath, he must confront whether justice or darkness will prevail.

title: Heart of a Woman
description: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax.

title: The Drive
description: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. The certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock.
